# Meet: Synthetic practice

Prepare the inputs from the main project folder:

```bash
Rscript scripts/R/prepare_synthetic.R
```

The matrix stores genes in rows and cells in columns. `cell-metadata.tsv` connects each cell to a sample and an optional reference label. `gene-metadata.tsv` flags mitochondrial genes explicitly.

Read [the input contract](../../data/your-study/README.md). The synthetic labels describe the simulation settings.

**Your task:** open both metadata tables; trace one cell ID to the matrix. Explain the difference between a cell, a sample and a donor.

This v2 dataset contains 1,000 genes and 200 cells. Seed `20261125` reproduces the random draws using the RNG settings in the script. Negative-binomial counts give cell-to-cell variation and zeros; unequal library sizes vary total counts. Four artificial sample labels are balanced across two simulated populations. The simulation is not fitted to the real dataset. See `data/synthetic/provenance.txt` for the construction and deliberate QC failures.
